arguments.command:
python -c '
import parse

# Test with different formats
formats = [
    "{}",           # default
    "{:<}",         # left-aligned  
    "{:^}",         # center-aligned
    "{:>5}",        # right-aligned
]

for fmt in formats:
    p = parse.compile(fmt)
    print(f"{fmt!r}: expr={p._expression!r}")
    result = p.parse("hello")
    print(f"  parse('hello') -> {result}")
    result = p.search("text hello more text")
    print(f"  search('text hello more text') -> {result}")
    print()
' 2>/dev/null

- For `{:^}` in text "  hello  ", we want to capture "hello" (non-space chars between spaces)

So the search regex should be:
- Left-aligned: `([^ ]+)` followed by whatever was there before
- Center-aligned: ` +([^ ]+) +` (capture non-space surrounded by spaces)
